stories.headline: IMF总裁警告：债务与借款成本持续攀升

freshness.quote: The head of the International Monetary Fund has called on governments across big economies to tighten their belts as soaring bond yields hit budgets.

evidence.quote: The head of the International Monetary Fund has called on governments across big economies to tighten their belts as soaring bond yields hit budgets.

claims.text: 她说，全球债务占GDP的比例处于二战以来最高水平，并可能在未来几年达到100%。这是她对债务趋势的判断。

evidence.quote: Speaking in Singapore, the IMF’s managing director, Kristalina Georgieva, said global debt-to-GDP ratios were at their highest level since the second world war and on course to hit 100% in the coming years.

stories.headline: OpenAI宣布在欧盟默认标记ChatGPT生成文本
